value.rationale: The q-ary first Hamming Fourier band is the canonical first frequency layer, and the split quadratic null cone is a natural finite-field restriction surface. The theorem determines an exact sharp energy-concentration constant, all singular values, and complete extremizers for every odd prime power and dimension. The nontrivial transition from a two-dimensional perfectly localized space at m=1 to no perfect localizers in higher dimensions and the five-level spectrum are structural, not a renaming or isolated numerical parameter.
